skills.name: conversion-rate-calculator
skills.description: Calculates website conversion rate (CVR) from conversions and visitors. Returns CVR percentage, revenue impact of improvements, and contextual benchmarks by industry.

skills.name: ab-test-significance-calculator
skills.description: Calculates statistical significance of A/B test results using a two-tailed z-test. Returns confidence level, z-score, p-value, relative lift, and a pass/fail/borderline verdict.

skills.name: ab-test-sample-size-calculator
skills.description: Calculates the minimum visitors needed per variant for a statistically valid A/B test given baseline CVR, MDE, significance, and power.

skills.name: ab-test-duration-calculator
skills.description: Calculates how many days an A/B test must run to reach required sample size. Enforces the 14-day minimum for day-of-week coverage and flags low-traffic scenarios.

skills.name: checkout-funnel-calculator
skills.description: Analyses e-commerce checkout funnel drop-off across up to 5 steps. Identifies the biggest revenue leak and estimates recovery value of a 10% fix.

skills.name: cart-abandonment-rate-calculator
skills.description: Calculates cart abandonment rate, monthly revenue lost, and recovery scenarios at 10%, 20%, and 30% recovery rates.

skills.name: landing-page-roi-calculator
skills.description: Calculates landing page CPA, ROAS, and revenue from ad spend and CVR inputs. Shows scenario table comparing revenue impact of 0–100% CVR improvements.

skills.name: customer-lifetime-value-calculator
skills.description: Calculates CLV/LTV, max profitable CAC at a chosen ratio, and a sensitivity table across multiple customer lifespan scenarios.

skills.name: form-conversion-calculator
skills.description: Calculates form funnel metrics — page-to-start and start-to-completion rates — and compares revenue impact of improving each to identify the higher-value fix.

skills.name: cro-roi-calculator
skills.description: Calculates monthly and annual incremental revenue from a conversion rate improvement given current traffic, CVR, AOV, and target improvement percentage.
